scripts.start: npm run start:web & npm run start:api
scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:api
scripts.test: npm run test:web && npm run test:api
scripts.cdk:synth: npm -w infra run build && cd infra && npx cdk synth
scripts.cdk:deploy: npm -w infra run build && cd infra && npx cdk deploy
scripts.cdk:diff: npm -w infra run build && cd infra && npx cdk diff
